Name: Going Sideways - an overworld sprite edit
Author: acekidprod
Description:
[center]--> THIS MOD IS A WORK IN PROGRESS <--
I'm working on it but I'm disabled and my hands hurt, sorry if I don't update very fast, please don't pressure me[/center]

This mod changes the overworld sprites to make them turn 45 degrees instead of 90 when they walk to the side. I love how it looks in Fields of Mistria and wanted to have the same in Stardew Valley. On top of that, I've altered the proportions of each character to make them look cuter and taller. Also, the characters have an alternative appearance when they're outside in the rain.
[u]
REQUIRED :[/u]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] --> absolutely required, won't work at all without it
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42083]Idle Plus Walk[/url] --> the walk cycle will look wonky if you don't install this mod

--> Highly recommend trying [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35341]The Stardew Squad[/url] to hang out with the characters, they look adorable and the mod is so much fun!

Please make sure to [u]turn off the other mods[/u] you have that change the overworld sprites of the currently available characters, you can check their options in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]. Going Sideways should update the sprites last, but sometimes it doesn't work, so make sure to pay attention to that. Note that it won't currently change anything below the walk animation.

[u]CURRENTLY AVAILABLE :[/u]
- Elliott : normal/rain
- Leah : normal/rain
- Sebastian : normal/rain/winter
- Sam : normal/rain/winter

--> currently working on Abigail, Haley and Maru are next

[u]TO-DO LIST[/u] (roughly in order of priority)
- every romanceable's walking sprite (normal/rain)
- every romanceable's walking sprite (winter)
- every non-romanceable's walking sprite (normal/rain/winter)
- some custom/modded NPCs I like playing with (Fleurine/Tea/Marlon/Gil/Wizard & more if I get the green light from the authors)
- everyone's beach sprite

Once everyone's walk cycle is done for each season, I will work on editing the animations.
